title: Pyroclastic Flow
description: Simulate falling rocks in a chamber and predict tower height after a trillion rocks.
writeup:
## Approach

Simulate rocks falling in a 7-wide chamber, pushed by jets and settling when they can't fall further. Five rock shapes cycle in order.

## Part 1

Direct simulation of 2022 rocks. Track filled positions in a set and compute tower height.

## Part 2

Simulating 1 trillion rocks directly is impossible. Instead, detect a cycle by hashing the state: current rock type, jet position, and the top profile of the tower (relative heights of each column). Once a cycle is found, skip ahead by full cycles and add the accumulated height, then simulate the remaining rocks.
